ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: A student divided seedlings of a higher plant into 4 groups (a, b, c, d), and placed them separately in sealed devices for cultivation under light. The light intensity of groups a, b, c, and d increased in sequence, and the temperature was kept constant during the experiment. After a period of time (t), the O2 concentration in the devices was measured, and the results are shown in the figure, where M is the initial O2 concentration, and the O2 concentrations of groups c and d are the same. Answer the question: If, when the illumination time is extended, the O2 concentration of groups c and d no longer increases, then at light time t, among a, b, and c, which group has the greatest photosynthetic rate?

ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: A student divided seedlings of a higher plant into 4 groups (a, b, c, d), and placed them separately in sealed devices for cultivation under light. The light intensity of groups a, b, c, and d increased in sequence, and the temperature was kept constant during the experiment. After a period of time (t), the O2 concentration in the devices was measured, and the results are shown in the figure, where M is the initial O2 concentration, and the O2 concentrations of groups c and d are the same. Answer the question: If, when the illumination time is extended, the O2 concentration of groups c and d no longer increases, then at light time t, among a, b, and c, which group has the greatest photosynthetic rate?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure, the vertical axis is O2 concentration, and the horizontal axis is the four groups a, b, c, and d; the dashed line marks the initial O2 concentration M. The column height of group a is approximately equal to M, group b is higher than M, and groups c and d are the highest and the two are the same. Then reason: In a sealed device, after the same illumination time t, the increase in O2 concentration relative to the initial concentration M can reflect the average net photosynthetic rate during that time. When temperature is constant, the effect of respiration rate is the same in all groups, so the larger the net photosynthetic rate, the larger the actual photosynthetic rate as well. Among groups a, b, and c, group c has the largest increase in O2 concentration, so at light time t, the group with the greatest photosynthetic rate is group c.
